description: This file defines a custom Swing menu item class 'MenuItem' that extends 'JMenuItem' and provides constructors to create menu items with text, actions, mnemonics, and accelerators.

classes.name: MenuItem
classes.description: A custom extension of JMenuItem that simplifies creation of menu items with associated actions, mnemonics, and accelerators.

methods.name: MenuItem(String, Action)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the MenuItem with display text and an associated Action.

methods.name: MenuItem(String, Action, int)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the MenuItem with display text, Action, and mnemonic key.

methods.name: MenuItem(String, Action, int, KeyStroke)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the MenuItem with display text, Action, mnemonic, and accelerator key.
